Pre-retrieval work focuses on the indexing structure and on query optimization, such as query rewriting, transformation and expansion. Post-retrieval work integrates the retrieved context through re-ranking chunks and context compression.","citationIds":["c2"]},{"text":"Retrieval strategies include hybrid approaches that combine keyword, semantic, and vector search, as well as sub-queries and hypothetical document embeddings (HyDE).","citationIds":["c3"]},{"text":"Retrieval can also be iterative or adaptive: methods such as FLARE and Self-RAG evaluate whether retrieval is necessary in a given scenario, rather than following a fixed retrieval process.","citationIds":["c3"]},{"text":"LightRAG proposes a dual-level retrieval paradigm that handles specific, entity-focused queries and abstract, conceptual queries, retrieving from both document chunks and their interdependencies.","citationIds":["c4"]},{"text":"Retrieval is evaluated with Recall@k, Precision@k, and F1@k.
